Test Case: Login with valid mobile number and default OTP
Preconditions: Staging site is available; authorized test mobile number is available
Test Data: Authorized test mobile; default OTP provided by event
Steps: 1. Open https://stg.gajab.com/ 2. Select Log in / Sign up 3. Enter the authorized mobile number 4. Request OTP 5. Enter the event-provided default OTP 6. Select Submit
Expected Result: User is logged in and the login control is replaced by the authenticated-state control

Steps: 1. Enter an invalid mobile number 2. Select Request OTP
Expected Result: Validation message is shown; OTP request is not sent

Steps: 1. Leave Mobile Number empty 2. Select Request OTP
Expected Result: Required-field validation is shown and the user remains on the login screen

Steps: 1. Enter an incorrect six-digit OTP 2. Select Submit
Expected Result: An error is shown and the user is not logged in

Steps: 1. Open the location selector 2. Enter 560037 3. Select the matching suggestion
Expected Result: Selected city and pincode are reflected in the header

Steps: 1. Enter an invalid pincode 2. Wait for suggestions
Expected Result: No invalid location is selected; a clear no-result or validation state is shown
